Carries the destroyed-workspace backup-retention backend from the merged `mngr/deploy-v0-3-9-debug` branch: server-stamped `destroyed_at` on workspace records, the hourly `backup_retention_reap` cron (bounded R2 bucket emptying, 30-day window), structural protection of workspace-backup buckets, the public `GET /policies/destroyed-workspace-backups` endpoint, and the `POST /admin/sweep/backup-retention` admin trigger. See `changelog/mngr-deploy-v0-3-9-debug.md` for the full description.
